clips.speaker: Bloomberg
clips.title: 超模卡莉·克劳斯收购杂志对抗数字时代
title_lines: 从封面女郎到媒体大亨
收购杂志对抗数字时代

subtitles.en: What are the most challenging economics of the magazine industry?
subtitles.zh: 杂志行业最具挑战性的经济问题是什么？
zh_highlights: 最具挑战性的经济问题

subtitles.en: Was the goal to reinvent the business model? Certainly. That's the goal.
subtitles.zh: 目标是重塑商业模式吗？当然，这就是目标。

subtitles.en: Like, I think, you know, most small, independent magazine businesses are folding because they're not thinking outside the box.
subtitles.zh: 我认为大多数小型独立杂志倒闭是因为缺乏创新思维。

subtitles.en: Time is up, yes, yes. There's so much going on, how can you fight for people's attention?
subtitles.zh: 时间不多了，是的。竞争如此激烈，如何争夺人们的注意力？

subtitles.en: What can we make that will actually break through and matter?
subtitles.zh: 我们能做出什么真正突破且有价值的东西？

subtitles.en: But let's start with Supermodel. A businesswoman, I invest in companies and ideas and people I believe in.
subtitles.zh: 但首先她是超模、商人，**于我看好的公司、创意和人。

subtitles.en: Money is power. And she's in the headlines, whether she wants them or not.
subtitles.zh: 金钱就是力量。无论她是否愿意，她总是登上头条。

subtitles.en: You and Joshua, very private people, is that intentional?
subtitles.zh: 你和约书亚非常注重隐私，这是有意为之吗？

subtitles.en: It is because we really care about our real life.
subtitles.zh: 是的，因为我们非常珍视真实的生活。

subtitles.en: Like, nobody else deserves access to that. Did it change when President Trump was elected?
subtitles.zh: 好像别人都不配接触这些。特朗普当选后，情况有变化吗？

subtitles.en: Long before that, as a model, I think it was definitely a line I had to walk.
subtitles.zh: 早在那之前，作为模特，我觉得这确实是一条需要谨慎行走的线。

subtitles.en: Now, in her biggest bet yet, she's going from cover girl to media model.
subtitles.zh: 现在，在她最大的一次赌注中，她从封面女郎转型为媒体模特。
zh_highlights: 封面女郎转型为媒体模特

subtitles.en: Buying up iconic magazines as the industry fights to survive in a world dominated by digital media.
subtitles.zh: 收购标志性杂志，而行业正在数字媒体主导的世界中挣扎求生。

subtitles.en: I think about it like we're running a startup inside a vintage car.
subtitles.zh: 我觉得这就像在一辆老爷车里运营一家初创公司。
zh_highlights: 老爷车里运营一家初创公司
en_highlights: running a startup inside a vintage car
